narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous, multi-persona sketch to explain the benefits of Taiwan's National Pension scheme. By satirizing the concept of '60 years old and being at peace with the world' (Er Shun), the creator connects emotional resilience with financial security provided by the government's pension plan, ultimately encouraging timely payments.
